Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.util.*;
class Main {
    public static int fairSplits(int arr[], int n)
    {
        int totalSum = 0;
        int count = 0;
        for(int i=0;i<n;i++) totalSum += arr[i];
        int prefixSum = 0;
        int suffixSum;
        int difference;
        for(int i=0;i<n-1;i++)
        {
            prefixSum += arr[i];
            suffixSum = totalSum - prefixSum;
            difference = Math.abs(prefixSum - suffixSum);
            if (difference % 2 == 0) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
      int n = 5;
      int arr[] = {10, 10, 3, 7, 6};
      int ans = fairSplits(arr, n);
      System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
